notes.title: General Update - Fire Demon Sneak Peek!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40085203/4e678d8d68ea3e067de81cd8920360be39eb508f.jpg[/img]
This infernal creature from hell, loyal to its master, Xardas, stands as the final trial for those seeking an audience with the necromancer within the desolate tower in the Orc lands.

Demons are servants of Beliar, the god of darkness, hatred, and destruction. You can encounter them in the depths of the ancient Sleeper Temple or summon them through the mastery of dark arts. But beware, delving too deeply into such power can lead to total consumption...

notes.title: General Update - Fire Lizard Sneakpeek!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40085203/f8c2b8749b5eddd4f2525faac7594a3b91b971c8.jpg[/img]
As you explore the sandy shores of Myrtana, watch out! Here, besides the usual lizards, you might run into fire lizards as well! Their crests glow with a red-bloody color, and their mouths spew terrible flames! These creatures are really risky! Even orcs avoid them, and not for no reason! After all, one of the ingredients for Ulu-Mulu is their tongue!

Be careful when encountering these fire beasts in the Orc lands and on the beach near the mysterious Fog Tower. For your own safety, don't forget to wear some kind of artifact that will protect you from the scorching flames! That way, dealing with them will be much easier. Otherwise, it's not just a HOT battle waiting for you, but a battle with the burning smell...

notes.title: General Update - Swampshark Sneakpeek!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40085203/eecfed6d99dd63f2b25d5853e460e3cd4af591c7.jpg[/img]

The Ulu-Mulu quest is a key moment in Gothic 1, representing one of the game's most dangerous and challenging missions. Among the ingredients needed to create it is the tooth of a swamp shark. To obtain it, you must return to the ominous and viscous swamp, facing the worm-like creatures. Be aware, as one of them may approach unnoticed, stealthily advancing beneath the water's surface!

notes.title: General Update - Skeleton Mage Sneakpeek!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40085203/f9aa34c5ef24619f05042a886365aab9e8d705be.png[/img]
There are so many places in the Minental that leave more questions than answers, don't they? The Fog Tower and the labyrinthine network beneath it, infested with an army of undead, instill fear and terror in any traveler who ventures inside. The catacombs, on the other hand, possess a certain allure. But before you delve into their depths, ask yourself a crucial question: "Are you ready to prove yourself worthy of receiving the Chromanin?"

notes.title: General Update - Harpy Sneakpeek!
notes.notes:
All the Focus Stones scattered throughout the Colony are guarded by dangerous, and at times even terrifying creatures. Do you recall the defenders of the magical artifact in Troll's Canyon and the inhabitants of the Mountain Fort, which you explore with your trusted companions, Diego and Lester? It's never a good idea to go there alone! Because these places are home to the insidious Harpies, whose piercing screams can make your ears bleed. The sound is unmistakable!

notes.title: General Update - Molerat Sneakpeek!
notes.notes:
Have you ever had a feeling of being left with unanswered questions after some quests in Gothic? Like the quest with the missing Nek from the Old Camp? How could a battle-hardened guard not handle three molerats? Sounds a bit weird and suspicious, doesn't it?   

But still, everything is possible and we should not deny this possibility. These pink-skinned creatures, hiding in caves from the bright sunlight, usually live in groups of 3-4 individuals, and together they can still be a threat!   

Well, let's take a closer look at the suspect, hm?

notes.title: General Update - Bloodfly Sneakpeak!
notes.notes:
Hey Gothic Community! 

Gothic 1 Remake’s development is in full swing and we would like to share everything at once, but let's leave something for dessert?  

Today we decided to give you a first look at a redesigned Bloodfly! 

Do you remember how much problems do these creatures cause in the early game? You should be aware of the poisonous sting of a Bloodfly or you will get into trouble! 

To avoid them, don’t come close to the places, where the soil is damp and the air is humid! The flies gather there, attracted by the sweat of all kinds of beings. They use their stings to kill their victims and feast on their blood. 

How do you like the new design? 

Join our discord here to be part of the conversation! - [url=https://www.discord.gg/gothic]Gothic Discord[/url]

notes.title: General Update - Minecrawler Sneak Peak & Call for Community Manager Application
notes.notes:
Back in March, we released a render of the actual in-game Scavenger created for the Gothic Remake to celebrate the 20th anniversary of Gothic. Since it’s been a while, we thought we would post another update. 
We really enjoyed the critical discussions and constructive feedback that came out of this post and so we will continue releasing key elements of the game that way.
Today we're bringing you a sneak peak of our interpretation of the Minecrawler.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40085203/e77558f174ec96a90274594371446db2a75ecded.jpg[/img]
We can assure you that they’re even more terrifying moving around in-game. We also came up with a small additional twist to these creatures, but there’ll be more on that in a later update.

Generally, we are very pleased to share that the development of the Gothic Remake is progressing on all fronts. We have assembled a team of over 35 specialized developers at our Barcelona office and are working with several contractors and outsources in addition. Gothic may be more than 20 years old, but the scope of this game cannot be underestimated.

We are also still looking for additional people to join our team. If you’re interested, you can check our open positions here: www.alkimiainteractive.com

Today, we want to put a special spotlight on the open position of Community Manager at Alkimia Interactive! We are looking for a versatile person to join us at our Barcelona office and help with coordinating our communication efforts and community presence, among other things. The most important part is to be passionate about Gothic and proficient in English and German (ideally Polish or Russian as well). You can find more details here: https://alkimiainteractive.com/callforcommunitymanager.html
